sources.title: llama3:8b
sources.snippet: Llama 3 The most capable openly available LLM to date. Meta Llama 3, a family of models developed by Meta Inc. are new state-of-the-art , available in both 8B and 70B parameter sizes (pre-trained or instruction-tuned). Llama 3 instruction-tuned models are fine-tuned and optimized for dialogue/chat use cases and outperform many of the available open-source chat models on common benchmarks. CLI ...

sources.title: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct API & Playground | Fireworks AI
sources.snippet: Llama 3.1 8B Instruct is a multilingual, instruction-tuned large language model developed by Meta. It is part of the Llama 3.1 family, which includes models at 8B, 70B, and 405B parameter scales.
